passedScope: capture-only; not the whole task card
summary: Six PNGs captured, decoded, and verified; each camera has two identical fresh-context takes. Clean-exit baseline incomplete: see cleanupDeviation.

cleanupDeviation.cause: The executed harness called browser.close() on a connect()ed browser, which only disconnects the client; after 15 s the harness force-killed the launched Chromium. All six captures and every validation check had already passed.
cleanupDeviation.postRunFix: The delivered harness now calls BrowserServer.close() for a launched server before any force-kill, and the review fixes make the output root configurable (FPS_CAPTURE_OUT_ROOT), create an exclusive preflight.json, ignore untracked files in the tracked-clean check, record httpServerListeningAfterClose with direct semantics, split self-reported vs observed exit codes, and print fatal errors to stderr. No capture or rerun was performed because the task forbids overwriting the exclusive output root or switching roots. A second review pass also distinguishes capture-failed from exit-baseline-incomplete, tees this process's stderr into PW_DEBUG_LOG, writes harness-fatal.json only after the output root is successfully claimed, and derives the local-evidence location note from the actual output root. A third review pass adds measured dependency verification before the build (package-lock.json SHA-256 plus the installed versions of vite/playwright/pngjs/three/typescript checked against the lock), with environment.dependencies and packageLockSha256 derived from those measurements.

harness.exitCodeSource: selfReportedExitCode is the executed harness's own exit intent (local executed report); observedExitCode is the OS-observed run exit (run-exit.json)
